title: Just Okay
text:
Just Okay. This is a really large storage bin. It has canvas outside and that fabric paper type stuff inside. The Chevron stripes don't perfectly match up at the corners, but they do come close enough not to bother me. It works for its purpose. But there are 2 main things that bother me with this basket.
(1) The rose gold, while beautiful, is scuffed up. It doesn't look pristine and perfect. And if it did, I'm now aware it wouldn't look that way for long. The rose gold paint on the canvas just shows the imperfections really easily.
(2) The edging isn't up to quality for me. There are too many fraying or not quite sealed areas between the lining and the outer fabric. I have had several containers by this brand, and this is probably the worst I have ever seen from them on the edge quality. So, this definitely only applies to this specific color.
So this pretty basket is really just okay. I use them. And they hold what I need them to hold. And they look okay on the shelf. But they aren't the quality I'm quite used to. So, if you're really digging the print, they might still make you happy. But if you are on the fence, the quality issues might annoy you too much.
